integrity: Analytical proof with independently replayable exact-rational, numerical-quadrature, and stochastic finite checks. No independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite unit-variance Gaussian Markov trees, nonsingular edge correlations. Common-sign conclusions require all edges to have strictly the same nonzero sign; mixed signs can cancel. Not a stochastic-ordering result. Fixed-correlation chain limit only. Inaccessible full text of Sinn and Keller (2011) is a historical-priority risk. Explicit all-positive-correlation Gaussian triples can violate the tree sign conclusion.
title: A path-square law for sign crossings and energy on Gaussian trees
